conventions.convention: A Jordan algebra has a commutative bilinear product over a field of characteristic other than two and satisfies x∘(y∘x²)=(x∘y)∘x²; a unit is an additional property.
Alternative means both x(xy)=x²y and (yx)x=yx²; neither associativity nor a unit is required by the definition.
The complex algebra involution is conjugate-linear, reverses products, squares to the identity, and fixes the unit. Its self-adjoint part is regarded as a real vector space.
Associative symmetrization is a∘b=(ab+ba)/2 on a unital associative algebra over a field of characteristic other than two.
Spin-factor coordinates are ordered (vector, scalar), with (v,α)∘(w,β)=(αw+βv,⟨v,w⟩+αβ), using a positive-definite real inner product.
The Clifford comparison assumes finite-dimensional V and the plus-Q relation v̄²=⟨v,v⟩1. Cone boundary means boundary in the induced norm product topology.
Octonions are quaternion pairs with (a,b)(c,d)=(ac−d̄b,da+bc̄), conjugation (a,b)↦(ā,−b), and ℓ=(0,1). In particular i(jℓ)=−kℓ.
Hermitian matrices have rows (a,x,z̄), (x̄,b,y), (z,ȳ,c), with real diagonal entries. Binary matrix multiplication uses the ordered sum (XY)ij=Σr XirYrj; matrix associativity is not assumed.

load_bearing.statement: As a real vector space, O=H×H; (a,b)(c,d)=(ac−d̄b,da+bc̄) and conjugation is (a,b)↦(ā,−b).

For a unital associative algebra over a field of characteristic other than two, a∘b=(ab+ba)/2 makes A⁺ a Jordan algebra. For a complex associative algebra with involution, its self-adjoint part is a real vector subspace closed under ∘, hence a real Jordan subalgebra.

Octonion conjugation satisfies conjugation squared equal to the identity and conjugate(xy)=conjugate(y)conjugate(x). For x=(a,b), x+conjugate(x)=(2a₀,0) and x conjugate(x)=conjugate(x)x=(N(a)+N(b),0), with real scalars embedded in the first quaternion coordinate.
For every real inner-product space V, the spin-factor product is commutative and bilinear, has unit (0,1), and satisfies x∘(y∘x²)=(x∘y)∘x².
For the specified real octonions, X∘Y=(XY+YX)/2 maps H₃(O)×H₃(O) into H₃(O) and makes it a unital real Jordan algebra.
The specified octonions have two-sided unit (1,0), satisfy both alternative laws, and are not associative: (ij)ℓ=kℓ but i(jℓ)=−kℓ.

For finite-dimensional real inner-product V with Q(v)=⟨v,v⟩, Φ(v,α)=v̄+α1 is an injective unital Jordan homomorphism onto R1+V̄ in Cl⁺(V,Q)⁺. The square cone is α≥‖v‖, with boundary α≥0 and α²−‖v‖²=0.

published_dependencies.used_for: Field axioms and scalar domains in the Jordan, alternative, and associative-product definitions.
Underlying vector-space structures in the Jordan, alternative, octonion, and Hermitian-matrix definitions.
Unital associative algebra convention, bilinearity, and central scalar multiplication in associative symmetrization and complex involutive algebras.
Complex conjugation in the conjugate-linear involution convention.
Positive-definite symmetric real inner products underlying spin-factor products.
Explicit coordinate multiplication, conjugation, real embedding, norm, and named units used throughout the octonion and Albert constructions.
Quaternion associativity and the identities aā=āa=N(a), used in octonion conjugation and alternativity.
Norm separation, homogeneity, triangle inequality, and resulting continuity in both spin-factor cone proofs.
Existence and uniqueness of nonnegative real square roots in the explicit square-cone converse constructions.

concerns.concern: Facts & Assumptions F2 says: “It fixes real matrix units and interchanges E_{12} with E_{21}.” The first clause is false for conjugate transpose: E_{ab}*=E_{ba}, so the real matrix unit E_{12} is not fixed. This contradicts the next clause and proof step 2.1. The worked counterexample uses the correct transpose rule and remains valid, but the stated fact requires correction.

seams_checked.note: Read the supplier page and its Clifford definition, polarized-relations lemma, and PBW theorem. The consumer uses exactly the finite-dimensional real specialization of the plus-Q convention, the relation v̄w̄+w̄v̄=2⟨v,w⟩1, and independence of the scalar and degree-one PBW elements. The supplier permits degenerate forms; the consumer's positive-definite specialization is legitimate. No ungraded exterior-algebra identification is imported.
